title: The not-found state renders with a naming heading, a parent-surface recovery link, a search entry and a tab title carrying the state name
asA: operator following a stale or mistyped link into the application
iWant: the not-found state to render with a heading naming the missing resource kind, a recovery link back up to the parent surface and a search entry, and a tab title reading Not found - <app>
soThat: I can name the resource I asked for, walk back up the resource hierarchy or search for the right one, and my browser tab distinguishes this state from the loaded surface

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given a 404 response on a route the SPA declares, the not-found state renders inside a role="region" with an accessible name naming the missing resource kind, a keyboard-reachable recovery link to the parent surface with data-recovery="parent-surface", a search entry with data-recovery="search", and the browser tab title matches /^Not found - .+/. The pack drives the real browser to /probe/not-found and reads all four surface tokens.
The not-found state distinguishes gone from never-existed only when the applied data blueprint supplies the removal record; otherwise the state renders as not-found with no gone-vs-never inference.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a not-found state on a resource id
acceptanceCriteria.then: when the applied data blueprint supplies a removal record the surface renders the gone variant, otherwise the not-found variant
